'''Shibuya''' is a major commercial and nightlife district in western [[Tokyo]].

== Understand ==
This district is particularly lively in the evening and is known for its inexpensive restaurants.

=== Climate ===
Summers are hot and humid.

== Get in ==
The district is centered on [[Shibuya Station]].

== Get around ==
Most attractions are walkable from the station.
